'''Jon Dickson''' (Japanese: '''トシヤ''' ''Toshiya'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP272|Johto Photo Finish]]''. He is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] from [[Sento Cherry Town]].

Jon was a competitor in the [[Silver Conference]]. He made it all the way to the semifinals, where he battled {{jo|Harrison}}. After defeating Harrison, he went on to win the finals. His Championship Trophy was given to him by [[Charles Goodshow|Mr. Goodshow]].
